messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: prod-api /v1/chat 5xx spike detected. 5xx > 15% over 3m in prod-region-a. Pager triggered -> PD:PD-4521. Runbook: /runbooks/api-5xx.

Sam (oncall): I'm taking this. initial hypothesis: gateway->decoder path. Priya, can you tail the gateway and decoder logs?

Priya: on it. starting tail on gateway pods and decoder. heads-up: tracing looks thin, no trace-ids on many requests.

Luis: confirming telemetry gap. tracing sampling seems normal but spans not reaching collector. Ops, any collector alerts?

Ops: collector shows TLS handshake errors starting ~02:10UTC; cert rotated yesterday and not all agents picked it up. filing ops ticket: OPS-2341.

Sam (oncall): ok; need a stopgap so we can correlate. two quick mitigation items: 1) inject a request id at the ingress/proxy so logs can be correlated end-to-end; 2) enable local span logging in decoder (stdout) until collector fixed. Priya, can you patch ingress?

Priya: adding envoy annotation to inject x-request-id and to stream headers to logs. applying to ingress-prod:
```
kubectl patch ingress api-ingress -n prod -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"envoy.filters.http.header_to_metadata":"x-request-id","envoy.access_log":"/dev/stdout"}}}'
```
Patch applied.

Priya: also toggling feature-flag to raise tracing sample rate for the route for 10m via config service: `POST /featureflags/sample-rate {"route":"/v1/chat","rate":1.0}`

Carla (support): customer reports: intermittent UI errors and failed requests for autocomplete and chat. Top impacted tenants: buildbox, tutorly. Logged customer severity and notified account teams.

Luis: decoder tracer agent logs show handshake failure to collector due to cert subject mismatch. Until ops fixes cert, I'll flip DECODER_TRACER=log for decoder pods.

Luis: applying env to decoder:
```
kubectl set env deployment/decoder -n prod DECODER_TRACER=stdout && kubectl rollout restart deployment/decoder -n prod
```
Rollout started.

Sam (oncall): decent. Also let's reduce pressure on decoder: enable degraded mode that disables expensive reranking stage for 20% of traffic and route to fallback simpler model for those requests. Priya, can you create a traffic-split?

Priya: creating split to send 80% to normal path, 20% to simple-model backend:
```
apiVersion: networking/v1
kind: TrafficSplit
metadata:
  name: chat-fallback-split
spec:
  service: api
  backends:
  - service: api-primary
    weight: 80
  - service: api-fallback
    weight: 20
```
Applied.

Sam (oncall): also temporarily increase decoder client timeout to 7s and add single retry with jitter. We'll monitor.

Luis: pushed decoder config override via k8s configmap:
```
request_timeout_ms: 7000
retries:
  max_attempts: 1
  jitter_ms: 150
```
Restarted.

Priya: testing via curl to LB to confirm x-request-id injection and new behavior:
```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"msg":"hello"}'
HTTP/2 502
x-request-id: 3d9f7c2a
```
We get x-request-id header back. logs now include x-request-id in both gateway and decoder for samples.

Luis: stdout spans are showing decoder spans and x-request-id in tags; I can trace a few failures. Looks like decoder spent 5.5s in external vectorizer call then timed out — so previous 3s timeout was too low under load. Vectorizer appears saturated.

Sam (oncall): confirmed root cause: vectorizer latency spike causing cascaded 5xx. For live mitigation: already increased decoder timeout, enabled retry, routed 20% to fallback, and injected request id + stdout spans. Next, Ops please scale vectorizer read replicas or open capacity.

Ops: scaling vectorizer to +3 pods and increasing DB connection pool size temporarily. ops ticket OPS-2341 updated.

Carla (support): advising impacted customers to retry with exponential backoff; posting status update to status.redwood.ai.

Priya: observability improvements in place: envoy now writing access logs to new index 'incidents-177050' for 30m and tracer sample rate bumped; forwarding configured via log-forwarder endpoint.

Luis: after changes, 5xx rate dropped from 15% -> 2.3% within 7 minutes. latency p95 improved but still slightly elevated.

Sam (oncall): good. next steps before handoff: 1) Ops: fix collector cert rotation and confirm agents reconnect (OPS-2341). 2) Platform: make request-id injection permanent and ensure header propagated to all services. 3) Infra: capacity plan for vectorizer. 4) Eng: postmortem and lessons learned; include alert tuning and runbook updates (Sam to lead).

Carla (support): I drafted a short customer message and will send after root cause confirmed.

Incident Bot: UPDATE: severity lowered to SEV-2. Current 5xx ~2.3%. Mitigations: ingress request-id injection, decoder tracer->stdout, decoder timeout/retry increase, traffic-split to fallback, vectorizer scale.

Sam (oncall): handing off to Priya for monitoring and follow-ups overnight. Priya, please confirm reverts and collector cert fix in the morning.

Priya: taking handoff. I'll keep an eye for 3hrs then hand to next oncall. leaving incident notes in the incident tracker INC-4521 and ops OPS-2341.

Sam (oncall): thanks team. Postmortem owners: Sam (lead), Priya (instrumentation/ingress), Ops (collector cert & vectorizer capacity), Luis (tracing). We'll schedule RCA within 72 hours.

Carla (support): added customer list to INC-4521 and notified AMs. :white_check_mark:
